questions.question: 1. Which of the following gates can be used as even parity generator?

explanations.a: Incorrect. The XNOR gate is suitable for odd parity generation, not even parity.
explanations.b: Correct. An XOR gate can be used as an even parity generator by combining all bits; it outputs 1 for odd number of 1s, ensuring even parity.
explanations.c: Incorrect. The OR gate cannot generate even parity; it only outputs 1 if any input is 1.
explanations.d: Incorrect. The NOR gate cannot generate even parity; it only outputs 1 when all inputs are 0.

questions.question: 2. Reduce the expression xy(z+w)+y(xz+xz)+zw and tell the min number of transistor required for the design.

explanations.a: Correct. 8 transistors are required for the simplified expression; this matches the minimum needed.
explanations.b: Incorrect. 6 transistors is not sufficient for the given expression.
explanations.c: Incorrect. 11 transistors is more than required for the given expression.
explanations.d: Incorrect. 12 transistors is more than required for the given expression.

questions.question: 3. How many NOR gates are required for realizing XOR gate?

explanations.a: Incorrect. An XOR gate cannot be implemented using just four NOR gates.
explanations.b: Incorrect. An XOR gate cannot be implemented using just three NOR gates.
explanations.c: Correct. Five NOR gates are required to realize an XOR gate.
explanations.d: Incorrect. An XOR gate cannot be implemented using fewer than five NOR gates.

questions.question: 4. Which of the following gates can be used for parity detection?

explanations.a: Incorrect. XOR gate alone detects odd parity, but both gates are needed for full parity detection.
explanations.b: Incorrect. XNOR gate alone detects even parity, but both gates are needed for full parity detection.
explanations.c: Correct. Both XOR and XNOR gates can be used for parity detection, depending on the parity type.
explanations.d: Incorrect. At least one of the gates can be used for parity detection.

questions.question: 5. What will be the minimum number of transistor required for designing xy+xz+zy+xy+z

explanations.a: Correct. 6 transistors are required for the simplified expression; this is the minimum needed.
explanations.b: Incorrect. 4 transistors is not sufficient for the given expression.
explanations.c: Incorrect. 3 transistors is not sufficient for the given expression.
explanations.d: Incorrect. 2 transistors is not sufficient for the given expression.
